description: This file defines the Customer model class for the Opencart catalog system, encapsulating operations related to customer data management such as creation, update, deletion, and retrieval of customer information, as well as handling customer-related actions like login, password management, and history tracking.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Represents the customer data management operations within the Opencart system, including creation, update, deletion, retrieval, and auxiliary actions such as login tracking and communication management.

methods.name: addCustomer
methods.description: Creates a new customer record with provided data, assigning appropriate customer group and handling approval if necessary.

methods.name: editCustomer
methods.description: Updates an existing customer's information identified by customer ID.

methods.name: editPassword
methods.description: Updates the password for a customer identified by email.

methods.name: editCode
methods.description: Sets a code field for password reset or email verification by customer email.

methods.name: editToken
methods.description: Assigns a token to a customer for purposes such as password resets or verification.

methods.name: editNewsletter
methods.description: Updates the newsletter subscription status for a customer.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Deletes a customer record and associated data such as activities, addresses, approvals, rewards, transactions, wishlists, histories, IPs, and authorizations.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves full customer details by customer ID.

methods.name: getCustomerByEmail
methods.description: Fetches a customer's data using their email address.

methods.name: getCustomerByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a customer record by a specific code, not equal to empty string.

methods.name: getCustomerByToken
methods.description: Fetches customer data associated with a specific token and clears the token afterward.

methods.name: getTotalCustomersByEmail
methods.description: Returns the total count of customers with a specific email for uniqueness checks.

methods.name: deleteHistory
methods.description: Removes historical data related to the specified customer.

methods.name: deleteIp
methods.description: Deletes a specific IP record associated with the customer.

methods.name: getIps
methods.description: Retrieves all IP records for the customer.

methods.name: getTotalIps
methods.description: Counts the total number of IP records for the customer.

methods.name: addLogin
methods.description: Logs a login event for the customer with IP and country info.

methods.name: addLoginAttempt
methods.description: Records a login attempt attempt by email, primarily for lockout or security measures.

methods.name: deleteLoginAttempts
methods.description: Deletes all login attempts associated with a specific email.

methods.name: getLoginAttempts
methods.description: Retrieves login attempt data for a customer identified by email.

methods.name: getAuthorizeByToken
methods.description: Fetches authorization data related to a specific customer and token, including attempts and related info.

methods.name: resetAuthorizes
methods.description: Resets the total attempts for customer authorizations.

methods.name: editAuthorizeStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a customer authorization record.

methods.name: editAuthorizeTotal
methods.description: Updates the total attempt count for a customer authorization.

methods.name: deleteAuthorize
methods.description: Deletes authorization records associated with a customer, optionally by specific authorization ID.
